name: Tawtheef AI - Smart Applicant Screening Assistant
description: A generative-AI assistant for the HR department of a mid-size Saudi logistics company (fictional: Sahil Al-Sharqiya Logistics, Dammam). It reads Arabic and English CVs uploaded through the public careers portal, extracts qualifications, scores each applicant 0-100 against the job description, produces a ranked shortlist for recruiters, drafts interview questions, and answers applicants' questions through a chatbot on the careers page. Applicants who score below 40 automatically receive a rejection email within 24 hours without any recruiter reviewing their file. Expected volume: about 18,000 applications per year across warehouse, driver, field-operations and office roles.
documentation:
DATA COLLECTED: full name, national ID or Iqama number, nationality, gender, date of birth, personal photo, mobile number, email, city, education, work history, certificates, expected salary. Nationality is used to track Saudization (Nitaqat) targets.

ARCHITECTURE: The careers portal and applicant database are hosted on a cloud region inside Saudi Arabia (Riyadh). For scoring, the full CV text (including name, ID number, nationality, gender, age and photo description) is sent to the OpenAI API (GPT-4o), which is processed outside the Kingdom. No cross-border transfer risk assessment has been completed. The OpenAI enterprise data processing agreement is under legal review and not yet signed; zero-data-retention has not been confirmed.

SECURITY: AES-256 encryption at rest and TLS 1.2+ in transit. Role-based access: only HR recruiters and the HR manager can view candidate files. Every score, shortlist and rejection email is written to an audit log retained for 3 years.

RETENTION AND LAWFUL BASIS: Hired candidates' data retained per employment records; unsuccessful applicants retained 12 months then deleted. Lawful basis is consent via a checkbox on the portal. The Arabic/English privacy notice exists but does not mention that an AI system scores or rejects applications.

HUMAN OVERSIGHT: Recruiters review the top-20 shortlist per vacancy; the hiring manager makes the final hiring decision. Applicants scoring below 40 are rejected automatically with no human review and there is no appeal or re-review process for them.

EXPLAINABILITY: The model returns a three-sentence rationale per candidate, visible to recruiters only; applicants are not told why they were rejected.

BIAS TESTING: A pilot on 1,200 historical applications found female applicants scored on average 6 points lower for field-operations roles, and applicants from certain cities scored lower. No mitigation has been implemented yet; gender and photo are still passed to the model.

GENAI SECURITY: No prompt-injection testing has been done (CVs can contain hidden white text instructing the model). No monitoring for model drift or output quality after go-live. The chatbot does not tell applicants they are talking to an AI.

CONTACT: Data Protection Officer - dpo@sahil-logistics.example
